title: Verify COMP-KERNEL and COMP-FIXTURES with `ia validate --verify-conformance`
summary: `ia validate --verify-conformance` runs the `package-v1` conformance profile of `@inventarch/compliance` in-process and reports COMP-KERNEL and COMP-FIXTURES with `basis: 'verified'`, so a starter workspace validates to a pass instead of not-evaluated, and a floor whose content differs from the embedded one fails COMP-KERNEL and exits 1. `--json` adds `conformance`: each check's outcome and basis, the profile, the toolchain, the floor and inventory digests and the suites the profile does not run. The human report adds a Conformance section. The evidence it records is what `ia validate` records without the flag, so every reader admits it. `openWorkspaceSession` in `@inventarch/distribution` accepts `conformance: 'verify'` and passes it to the db reader. Without the flag nothing new runs and the output is unchanged.
